violations.title: Thermometers, Location in Holding Units
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device in the following mechanically refrigerated unit was not properly located in the warmest part of the unit: thermometers could not be. Located at the front of some of the units for easy monitor of the ambient temperatures.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanically refrigerated unit the sensor of a temperature measuring device shall be located to measure the air temperature of a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of the refrigerator. Store the thermometer near the door of the unit. Place a thermometer at the front section, in each of the unit.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Crates found being used as racks to elevate supplies above the floor, inside the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: The interior base of the 1-door reach-ion refrigerator at the smoothie station was noted to be in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean inside this unit frequently to prevent dirt build-up.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the is not maintained in good repair. The grease trap appears to give off odor and may not be seal;ed tight.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Check the tray and sealed tightly.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. Employees handling foods, were observed wearing watches and bracelets on their arms.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor inside the walk-in freezer is in need of cleaning. The drain pipes under the 3-compartment sink are heavily soiled and in need of cleaning.
